body.statement: Can the handle in \(\text{def:legal-relative-handle}\) establish, for \(r_n=a_n/2\), \[\limsup_{n\to\infty}\sup_{P_n\in\mathcal M}P_n\!\left[\sqrt n\|\Phi_{\mathrm{ext}}(\widehat p_n)-\Phi(p_n)\|_\infty>Q_{1-\alpha}\{E_{p_n,r_n}(G^*)\mid\widehat p_n\},\ B_n\ne\varnothing,\ M(\widehat p_n)>0\right]\le\alpha,\] together with uniformly vanishing probability of the fallback event \(\{B_n=\varnothing\}\cup\{M(\widehat p_n)=0\}\), including arrays with zero cells, simultaneous active-cut ties, and \(Q_{1-\alpha}\{E_{p_n,r_n}(G^*)\mid\widehat p_n\}\to0\), where each displayed conditional quantile uses the lower-quantile convention?
body.justification: This is the nonroutine legal-inner-neighborhood and relative-quantile step on which honest support adaptation rests, with the total-procedure fallback accounted for explicitly.
body.gap: Andrews and Guggenberger obtain uniform inference from standardized moment-statistic representations with positive component variances, and Imai and Okamoto begin from uniformly asymptotically linear endpoint estimators with standard deviations bounded away from zero. Neither result constructs the legal observed-law lift for this changing rational capacity map or transfers its critical value when the full endpoint scale collapses.
body.consumer: A positive resolution yields honest inference without trimming rare survivor strata; failure on the explicit \(K=4\) array would delimit the feasible adaptation class.

obligation.what_is_open: Prove the displayed uniform relative comparison between the empirical endpoint error and the conditional quantile of the legal inner-neighborhood envelope when that quantile may converge to zero.
obligation.obstruction: The empirical segment from \(p_n\) to \(\widehat p_n\) need not remain in the nonconvex legal observed-law image. The finite capacity-face fundamental-theorem argument therefore supplies ambient or capacity bases, not the legal observed-law bases used by \(E_{p_n,a_n/2}\). Absolute Gaussian coupling error is also insufficient when the envelope quantile vanishes; a relative legal realization bound or a local-flatness certificate is still missing.
obligation.attempted: I checked the finite sign/cut decomposition, the exact legal tangent domain, positive-cell quotient bounds, empty-cell homogeneous ray formulas, common-square-root multinomial Gaussian coupling, and the nearby-base padding mechanism on an unseen rare atom. These routes prove fixed-scale regular faces, tight critical values, and the explicit \(K=4\) array, but they do not establish legal capacity-derivative domination uniformly over every irregular array.
obligation.partial_result: The following components are proved in the other target proofs of this solve unit: \(\sup_{P_n\in\mathcal M}P_n(B_n=\varnothing\text{ or }M(\widehat p_n)=0)\to0\); the conditional critical values are uniformly tight; the claimed comparison holds at every fixed separated regular face; and it holds on the explicit \(K=4\) emerging-support, rare-atom, tied-cut array.  What remains is the displayed relative legal-inner-neighborhood comparison on arbitrary irregular triangular arrays, especially when its conditional quantile tends to zero.
